clue.text: Worker coming up about one to see Jacob's daughter

indicators.note: about means the turned word wraps around the numeral
in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, a farm hand
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A labourer climbs about to visit a Biblical patriarch's girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' turns HAND into DNAH, and 'about' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Leah bore the patriarch a daughter named Dinah.

parts.note: sounds like a card cheat's knife or a dealer cutting a deck, but the pack is pack ice and the tool is a climber's

explanation.surface: Something that cuts a deck of playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountaineer's tool for chopping steps in frozen slopes and floes.

indicators.note: terrible means the letters of the name are in a dreadful jumbled state

explanation.surface: A man called Laurence looks awful dressed in blue, or looks miserable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges LAURENCE; 'looks' is a link and 'in blue' seems to be his sad mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Cerulean is a deep sky shade of that colour.

indicators.note: embellished means the letters are dressed up and rearranged into a new form

explanation.surface: A question admiring the decorated cathedral city of Ely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embellished' rearranges the letters of ISNT ELY; Ely is a small English cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with style means doing it with fashion and grace.

clue.text: We are in the pink having taken gold for the French painter

indicators.note: having taken means the gold is added on after the rest
are in means the pronoun is placed inside the colour word

parts.note: rose is a shade of pink
us is the object form of we
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: We are in excellent health after winning gold, all thanks to the French artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the pink' looks like the idiom for healthy, but pink is ROSE; 'are in' puts US inside it, giving ROUSSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Rousseau was a French naive artist known for jungle scenes.

clue.text: Chap to leave a served vegetable

parts.note: a chap is a man
to leave is to get out

explanation.surface: A man walks off and leaves a vegetable dish on the table.
explanation.walkthrough: The French name literally means 'eat all', as the whole pod is served and eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: A type of pea eaten pod and all, also called snow pea.

clue.text: Criminal worker found after awful crimes

indicators.note: found after means the insect is placed behind the jumbled letters
awful means the letters of crimes are in a terrible jumbled state

parts.note: a worker is a type of ant

explanation.surface: A labourer is identified after some dreadful offences have been committed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' rearranges CRIMES into MISCRE, and 'found after' puts ANT behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a wrongdoer or villain.

clue.text: A number take exam, naturally it's hard

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: Many people sit a test, which of course is difficult.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naturally it's hard' describes the stony skeleton reef animals build in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Coral is a stony substance formed by marine polyps in nature.

clue.text: One step up from the gutter

definitions.text: One step up from the gutter

parts.words: One step up from the gutter
parts.note: sounds like someone slightly better off than the destitute, but means the raised edge of the pavement beside the drain

explanation.surface: A person only slightly better than living in poverty.
explanation.definitionFit: The stone edging of a pavement stands a step above the roadside drain.

parts.note: sounds like a jug made of stone, but means a thing that pitches stones

explanation.surface: A jug made of stoneware.
explanation.definitionFit: A forked stick with elastic, used to hurl small rocks.

indicators.note: housing means the quarters hold the soldiers inside them

parts.note: quarters are compass points, here east, north and north

indicators.note: retired means the soldiers go back, read backwards

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: An officer's lodgings accommodate former troops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns GIS into SIG and 'housing' puts it in EN-N; 'Officer's' stands for 'officer is'.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensign is a junior commissioned rank in navies and formerly in the army.

indicators.note: shuffling means the letters of feet are mixed up

explanation.surface: People shuffle their feet around a market.
explanation.definitionFit: A fete is a fundraising fair with stalls, much like a charity sale.

parts.note: sounds like a programme or a guide, but means the text an opera is sung to

explanation.surface: A volume to read at the opera house.
explanation.definitionFit: The words of an opera are called its book or text.

clue.text: Catch line, unravel using a specialised skill

indicators.note: unravel means the letters of catch line are untangled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions for untangling a fishing line.
explanation.definitionFit: Technical means requiring expert, specialist knowledge.

definitions.meaning: going towards, as a ship steering for port
the caption at the top of a page or chapter

explanation.surface: Aiming to win a championship.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading for means travelling towards, and a heading is the title above a text.

indicators.note: in a down clue, goes on means the money sits on top of the fruit

parts.note: dough is slang for money
a nut is botanically a type of fruit

explanation.surface: Cash is spent on a fruit cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fruit cake' looks like one item, but fruit gives NUT and cake is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A doughnut is a small fried ring or ball of sweet batter, a type of pastry.

clue.text: Drop out at university to prepare for the theatre

parts.note: to scrub is to cancel or strike out a plan
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student quits university to train for the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'theatre' suggests the stage, but it is the operating theatre, where surgeons wash thoroughly.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons wash hands and arms carefully before an operation.

clue.text: Go away when it's cloudless on holiday

parts.note: a cloudless sky is clear
off work means on holiday

explanation.surface: Leave on vacation when the weather is fine.
explanation.definitionFit: A brusque command telling someone to leave, like 'get lost'.

indicators.note: inside means the dog's name sits within the metal symbol

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
Rover is a traditional name for a dog

explanation.surface: Observed a dog's name tag inside a leash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like a past tense and 'lead' like a leash; they are a saying and the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim.

clue.text: Ought, with hesitation, to take responsibility

parts.note: ought means should
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone hesitantly admits they ought to accept the blame.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear a burden or accept a duty, as on one's own back.

clue.text: Drug quietly injected into a rabbit

indicators.note: injected into means the soft letter is put inside the animal

parts.note: a doe is a female rabbit
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly

explanation.surface: A narcotic is discreetly given to a lab rabbit.
explanation.definitionFit: Dope is slang for cannabis or any narcotic.

parts.note: corn has heads of grain, and the same word names the parts of the head that stick out from it

explanation.surface: Asking what the best points of a cereal harvest are.
explanation.definitionFit: The grain heads of maize, and the organs of hearing that protrude from the head.

indicators.note: change means the letters of owner are rearranged

explanation.surface: Celebrity caused a proprietor to alter his name.
explanation.definitionFit: Renown is wide acclaim and celebrity.

clue.text: Charm, going topless at fashionable race meeting

indicators.note: going topless means the word loses its first letter, its top in a down clue

parts.note: a mascot is a lucky charm

explanation.surface: A good-luck charm going topless at a smart racecourse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going topless' drops the first letter of MASCOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal Ascot is a smart English horse-racing event in Berkshire, famous for hats.

parts.note: a see is a diocese, so its man is the cleric heading it; he is also a piece on a chessboard

explanation.surface: Look at a man boarding a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior cleric over a diocese, and a chess piece moving diagonally.

indicators.note: about means the poem wraps around the number

parts.note: a verse is a poem
an ace is one in cards

explanation.surface: A poem written about a great Italian artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Paolo Veronese was a Venetian Renaissance artist.

parts.note: a wage is pay
up means an increase, as in prices are up

explanation.surface: Agree a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle a debt is to hand over the money owed.

clue.text: Import teak, maybe, carried by sea

definitions.text: Import teak, maybe, carried by sea

parts.words: Import teak, maybe, carried by sea
parts.note: sounds like timber shipped as trade, but means any timber washed ashore by the waves

explanation.surface: Bringing in hardwood timber by ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Timber floated in on the tide and washed up on beaches.
